protocol.scope: Frozen city development histories under the same independent ordered-trip belief, with a fresh independent V10 seed at every root. Evaluate two prefixes of the same world stream. Family inference uses only the station-MCT e-mixture. Zero-MCT and old formulas are descriptive.
protocol.corridor: Cap at min(deadline, t+ceil(U+60)), then prune only trips unable to arrive before that cap in a hard-support interval relaxation. The clipped sample is pointwise <= the primary sample, so its e-mixture also bounds the unclipped station-MCT mean.
protocol.timing: Cold wall by phase, with a fresh belief in each arm. Both prefixes derive from the single measured 128-world arm per transfer/corridor setting.
